usedFor: MailChimp holds subscribers and Cloze holds relationships, and “Create a Person” adds each new subscriber to Cloze.

bestTemplate.name: “When a new subscriber is added to an audience” in MailChimp, then “Create a Person” in Cloze
bestTemplate.why: New subscribers appear in Cloze as people, so follow-up lives next to your other contacts.

watchOut: “When a subscriber unsubscribes from an audience” also leads to “Create a Person”, so unsubscribes would add people too.
